title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program Fee Computation: Late Pickup Fee Amount
content:
**Computation clause.** In the Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program, the late pickup fee is charged on the enrollment's most recently recorded chargeable late pickup, the latest by day of care. Its minutes late and its semester are the ones recorded on that pickup. The fee is the pickup's minutes late multiplied by the program's late pickup fee per minute. Minutes late are counted from the plan's after-school close time itself. The fee is rounded to the nearest cent, half a cent rounding up.

**2026-27 schedule.** For a late pickup of the 2026-27 school year, the fee is figured under the board-approved 2026-27 late pickup fee schedule. Each part of that schedule either sets a quantity that multiplies the minutes or sets a flat charge. The multiplying quantities act on the billed minutes together, as one product. The flat charges are then added. The total is rounded once, to the nearest cent, half a cent rounding up. A late pickup of any other school year is charged its minutes late multiplied by the per-minute fee.

The per-minute fee is the program's late pickup fee per minute shown in the plan figures for late pickups.

## Elements of the computation

| Element | Where it comes from |
|---|---|
| The pickup priced | the enrollment's latest chargeable late pickup in the attendance log |
| Minutes late | the whole minutes recorded on that pickup, counted from the close time |
| Per-minute fee | the program's late pickup fee per minute |
| Rounding | once, to the cent, half a cent rounding up |

## Worked figures (hypothetical per-minute fee of 0.80)

| Minutes late recorded | Product of minutes and per-minute fee | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| 7 | 5.60 | 5.60 |
| 23 | 18.40 | 18.40 |
| 37 | 29.60 | 29.60 |

An enrollment whose attendance log shows only a waived first incident and no chargeable late pickup has no fee to compute. When two chargeable late pickups are recorded on different days, the one on the later day of care is the one priced.
